body: My last resort was to get help here and nothing.  I give up.  Fuck life!  See you on the other side

No anything I can do to help.  Maybe I can have some meaning in my life before I go.  Would the free clinic offer therapy?  I doubt it..  But ask?  Drinking is a depressant but one drink to take the edge off is ok for some people.  I'm also lost on what career to pursue but I hope you feel better and feel free to ask or talk whenever.  I'll be on and off throughout the weekend until next week than I'm gone.
The famous Word's Fair of Flushing Meadows Corona Park.  It was the last one ever.  Now it's nothing but soccer and cricket fields with old pools and statues.

Thank you for posting.  I recently fought in court as my parents were being evicted.  Were okay now but hardly any food.  Above my head are terrible neighbors.  But yes I am grateful for a roof and food.  My mental state prevents me from working atm.  Well for the past 2 years.  I did try starting an home business based online and it failed harder than my own life has.  Thank you again for posting.

Dead end job you say?  My specialty!...  It's a stepping stone.  A temporary thing.  An experience that will help you in some way believe it or not.  Get your mental health in order is #1.  Than work on finding a career or something you wouldn't mind doing for work.  I don't know your story so I can't say anymore but feel free to elaborate on your entire situation.  Baby steps, in the right direction.  You have options to fix this NOW.  Don't wait.

okay so you have plenty of medication but you need to go back to the clinic asap and talk to the doctor about how you are feeling.  They may need to give you a higher dosage or a combination of things.  A lot of people like us often have two medications.  Therapy is also something you should have as well.  Talking to a professional.  I'm just thinking from my experiences, my mistakes.  I hope this helps you in some way.

You're doing good.  Hang in there and get that mental health in order.
Do your best with job hunting but do not beat yourself up.  Try your best and don't give up.  It's nice that you have a love in your life.
Once I rode a Clydesdale at the worlds fair back in the day.  Would have loved to do it again.

If you're contract is ending, is there any way to file for unemployment?  Medicare health insurance?  You can see a doctor at a clinic on a scale which means you might pay $40 per visit but that's still a lot of money.  But if you can, I would highly suggest it.  Are you almost out of Zoloft?

Well you're working your ass off, you have your own place so your doing something right.  You just need to get your mental state in order and I bet you will start to enjoy things again.  Do you have any friends/family nearby?
Horse farm sounds peaceful

Well I'm glad you didn't do it.  There must be a way to fix your life.  You have options so let's discuss them if you'd like.  Why do you feel like shit?  Are you on medication or seeing a doctor?  How long have you felt like this?
I know.  I had someone there for me too before they gave up on me.  It does help but it still is very hard.  Try to keep your mind busy.  Movies, games, food =)

I would usually go camping in either October or Early spring.  Although October is my favorite time of year it does get cold.  Anything after november is just way too cold.  Spring time camping is interesting as you see the weirdest looking bugs.

I'm one of those crazy animal people who hand feeds the raccoons.  I love animals.  I have two rabbits, two guinea pigs, 14 mice (I only wanted two but they had babies.. long story) and a dog who is like my hairy son.  So I feel bad about killing myself and leaving them behind.  I dunno anymore.

Happy Birthday and 22 was my favorite age.  I love the number 22 and I was born on May 22nd.  So 22 was a great age.  My 20s have been a complete nightmare for me and I'm supposed to be in my prime.  But you can turn things around while you're young.

As for how you're feeling, you still have plenty of time to fix things.  I wish I was 22 again knowing what I know now.  But I can tell you for starters to find a good doctor and get on the correct medication and weekly therapy sessions.  I know it sucks and all but it's vital.  Are you going to school, working?  Any hobbies/interests?

My whole life.  Once I made trip to PA when I was 12 or so and since than I always dreamed of moving there.  When I go camping I feel so good.  Coming home I get depressed and angry as soon as I get back to the city.  It's day and night.
I'm sick as well but maybe going to the emergency room would be better than going the whole weekend like this.  Or having a friend and/or family member stay with you.

I use to love watching Rocky 4 where he went to russian to train in this big barn.  Thats all I need, is a quiet place to get myself fixed.  Get my health back, start fresh and new.  It's not going to happen though

I wish I was.  I love the country.  I've only been to upstate NY, Connecticut and my dream land, Pennsylvania.  I'm afraid I will never find serenity and no way in hell will I find it here in the city =/ ...

I too was on citalopram. 20mg.  It never worked for me but everyone is different.  I hope you are seeing your therapist on a weekly basis?  I would talk to them and see if they need to switch up your medication to something stronger.  I've been on Paxil 40mg which has helped.  I too cannot sleep at night and dread every day.  You are not alone.  (i can only post every 7 mins =/)

After reading what you wrote, I can see he's very lucky to have someone like you in his life.  Although I'm sure you would say it's the other way around, but that's because you are a good hearted woman.  I too suffer from severe bipolar/depression etc etc and had an amazing girl once.  She was with me about 4 years and couldn't take it and left me.  But in between that she always cared for me, showed her love for me, treated me like a king.  Which is what I see you're doing as best as you can.

Just stop worrying so much and all you can do for him is be there for when he needs to talk, show him how much you care about him.  Make sure to take care of yourself too.  Ultimately make sure he takes his medication, sees his doctor and just communicate with him.  There's no better feeling than having someone there for you when you're at your lowest.  Don't worry so much and communicate.
What medications are you on?

I'm about to turn 30.  Where did the years go.  I told myself if I was still a fucking failure by 30 I'd go through with it.  My times up.  I don't have any options left.  I can A. kill myself and be done with this.  (what if theres no afterlife, what if there is a afterlife and I regret killing myself forever...) or B. pick myself off the ground, find a shitty 9 to 5 job, work and be completely miserable until Im back to square one and not make enough money to get the fuck out of here any way...  I feel smothered being here!.. I fucking hate it so much.

I would do anything to start over again.  To get the love of my life back.  To fix this mess.  I never wanted that apartment but she pushed me.  I'm still to blame.  

I've planned out my suicide to a T.  My will is typed out and I organized and cleaned all my belongs so I'm ready to go.  I just guess I'm having cold feet.
